ps.en: A restless [[youth]] left the [[welfare]] office and stepped into a [[zone]] where the traffic seemed to [[whirl]] without end. He had come to [[browse]] the small shops, but the crowds moved in a [[zigzag]] that made him dizzy.
ps.zh: 一个不安的年轻人离开福利局，走进一个车流仿佛永不停歇地打转的地带。他本是来逛小店的，可人群走出之字形的路线，让他头晕。

ps.en: The city felt [[weird]] at dusk, and a neighbor would often [[whisper]] that the rent here did not [[yield]] enough to live on. He found the [[key]] to a side door and slipped into a workshop where workers [[knit]] warm clothes for the poor.
ps.zh: 黄昏时这座城市显得古怪，常有邻居低声说，这里的房租根本不值得人留下谋生。他找到一扇侧门的钥匙，溜进一间工坊，工人们正在那儿为穷人编织暖衣。

ps.en: Business was [[brisk]] but the help was only [[brief]]; still, the boy left believing the city's noise could be survived. A bus would [[zoom]] past, and he learned to read its route like a map.
ps.zh: 生意兴隆，但帮手只来了一小会儿；尽管如此，男孩离开时相信，这座城市的喧嚣是可以熬过去的。一辆巴士呼啸驶过，他学着像看地图一样读懂它的路线。

ps.en: The committee's first [[aim]] was to [[aid]] families who felt [[alien]] in their own town. They would [[allocate]] funds and [[allow]] volunteers to [[alternate]] shifts at the shelter.
ps.zh: 委员会的首要目的是援助那些在自己镇上感到疏离的家庭。他们会分配资金，并允许志愿者在收容所里轮班。

ps.en: An [[aggressive]] developer tried to [[alter]] the plan, which began to [[agitate]] the neighbors and [[aggravate]] old tensions. The noise was enough to [[alarm]] even the most [[agreeable]] resident.
ps.zh: 一个咄咄逼人的开发商试图改变计划，这开始让邻居们躁动，也加剧了旧有的紧张。那喧闹足以惊动即便最随和的居民。

ps.en: In the end they reached an [[alternative]]: sell the land and [[alienate]] the deed to the city, whose [[aggregate]] budget could protect it. A small victory, but a real one.
ps.zh: 最终他们达成一个替代方案：卖掉土地，把契约转让给城市——其总预算足以保护它。一场小胜，但货真价实。

ps.en: Two labs began to [[compete]] for the same grant, and the [[competition]] grew fierce. To [[compare]] their results, the review board asked each team to [[compile]] a clear report.
ps.zh: 两个实验室开始争夺同一笔经费，竞争变得激烈。为了比较结果，评审委员会要求每个团队整理出一份清晰的报告。

ps.en: A [[comparative]] study showed the two methods were roughly [[comparable]], though one had a clear [[complement]] the other lacked. No one could [[compel]] a lab to change its approach, nor [[compensate]] it for lost time.
ps.zh: 一项比较研究显示，两种方法大致可比，尽管其中一种有一个对方所缺的互补之处。没人能迫使一个实验室改变方法，也没人能为它损失的时间作出补偿。

ps.en: Only the most [[competent]] students stayed calm in such a [[competitive]] field. By [[comparison]], the rest began to [[complain]], and one formal [[complaint]] reached the dean.
ps.zh: 在如此竞争激烈的领域，只有最有能力的学生能保持冷静。相比之下，其余人开始抱怨，一份正式投诉递到了院长那里。

ps.en: A new [[employee]] was hired to [[employ]] a calmer style of management. The system was [[complex]], and the trainer warned that one mistake could [[complicate]] the whole process.
ps.zh: 一名新员工被雇来采用更沉稳的管理风格。这套系统很复杂，培训师警告说，一个失误就可能让整个流程变复杂。

ps.en: To [[complete]] the task she had to [[comply]] with strict rules, though the instructions were long and [[complicated]]. The manager placed the [[emphasis]] on safety, would [[emphasize]] one point, then [[diffuse]] the lesson across many examples.
ps.zh: 为了完成任务，她必须遵守严格的规则，尽管说明冗长而繁琐。经理把重点放在安全上，会强调一点，再把这堂课分散到许多例子中。

ps.en: Her work did not [[differ]] much from others, but the small [[difference]] earned a rare [[compliment]]. She learned that tone matters as much as method.
ps.zh: 她的工作与他人并无太大不同，但那小小的差别为她赢得了一声难得的称赞。她明白了，语气和方法同样重要。

c: a weird coincidence 离奇的巧合
words.dif: weird 强调超乎寻常的怪，常带一丝神秘或不安；odd 只是不寻常，语气更轻
words.pat: The silence after the accident felt deeply weird.
words.patZh: 事故之后的寂静让人觉得极其怪异。

fam: welfare state 福利国家 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: welfare 多指社会或政府提供的福利；wellbeing 侧重个人幸福安康
words.pat: The reform aimed to improve child welfare across the region.
words.patZh: 这项改革旨在改善该地区儿童的福利。

c: a whirl of activity 忙乱
words.dif: whirl 强调快速旋转或思绪纷乱；spin 泛指转动；rotate 多指绕轴规律转动
words.pat: The leaves whirl in the wind on an autumn afternoon.
words.patZh: 秋日的午后，落叶在风中打着旋。

c: whisper a secret 低声说秘密
words.dif: whisper 是有意压低声音的耳语；murmur 是含糊不清的低语；mutter 常带不满
words.pat: She whispered that the meeting had been cancelled.
words.patZh: 她小声说会议已经取消了。

c: yield a profit 产生利润
fam: yielding adj. 易弯曲的；顺从的
words.dif: yield 作屈服常与 to 搭配；作产出时近 produce；作名词指产量
words.pat: The investment yielded a steady return over five years.
words.patZh: 这项投资在五年内带来了稳定的回报。

c: in one's youth 在年轻时
the youth of today 当今青年
fam: youthful adj. 年轻的；有活力的
words.dif: youth 作集合名词指青年一代，作个体可指小伙子；youngster 更口语
words.pat: The youth questioned whether the old rules still made sense.
words.patZh: 那个年轻人质疑，旧规矩是否还有意义。

c: in a zigzag 呈之字形
a zigzag path 蜿蜒小径
words.dif: zigzag 强调左右交错的之字形；winding 强调弯曲盘绕，不一定是锯齿状
words.pat: The trail zigzags up the mountain in a series of sharp turns.
words.patZh: 小径以一连串急转弯之字形盘山而上。

words.dif: zone 强调按功能或特征划出的带、区；region 多指自然或行政大区
words.pat: The city has declared this street a pedestrian-only zone.
words.patZh: 该市已宣布这条街为步行专用区。

c: zoom in / out 放大 / 缩小
fam: zoom lens 变焦镜头 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: zoom 指快速移动或急剧上升，常带画面感；soar 多指价格或高度飙升
words.pat: House prices in the district zoomed during the boom.
words.patZh: 繁荣期该区房价急剧上涨。

words.exam: 答案；关键；主要的；关键的
c: the key to 通往…的关键
a key factor 关键因素
words.dif: key 作形容词是关键，作名词可指钥匙、答案、关键；crucial 仅表重要
words.pat: Communication is the key to a healthy relationship.
words.patZh: 沟通是健康关系的关键。

words.dif: knit 用针织出衣物或使紧密结合；weave 多指用织布机织；unite 仅表联合
words.pat: The crisis knit the divided community together at last.
words.patZh: 危机最终让这个分裂的社区紧密团结起来。

c: a brisk trade 生意兴隆
words.dif: brisk 可形容生意兴隆或步伐轻快；lively 侧重活泼有生气
words.pat: A brisk wind swept the leaves across the empty square.
words.patZh: 一阵劲风把落叶扫过空旷的广场。

c: a brief visit 短暂拜访
a brief summary 简要总结
words.dif: brief 强调时间短或内容简；short 泛指短，最中性；concise 专指简洁
words.pat: Let me be brief: the plan needs more time and money.
words.patZh: 我长话短说：这计划需要更多的时间和资金。

c: browse the web 上网浏览
words.dif: browse 指随意浏览或动物吃草；scan 是带目的快速扫读；graze 仅指吃草
words.pat: She likes to browse second-hand bookshops on weekends.
words.patZh: 她喜欢周末逛二手书店。

c: aggravate the situation 使情况恶化
aggravate a crime 加重罪行
words.dif: aggravate 使问题或矛盾加重恶化；worsen 最通用；exacerbate 更书面
words.pat: Cutting the budget will only aggravate the housing shortage.
words.patZh: 削减预算只会让住房短缺更加严重。

words.dif: aggregate 强调整体合计、总计；total 最常用；sum 偏数学加法
words.pat: In the aggregate, the two regions produced similar results.
words.patZh: 总体来看，两个地区得出的结果相近。

words.exam: 好斗的；侵略的；积极进取的
c: an aggressive salesman 咄咄逼人的推销员
an aggressive investor 积极进取的投资者
words.dif: aggressive 可中性指积极进取，也可贬义指好斗、侵略；assertive 仅褒义果断
words.pat: An aggressive competitor pushed hard to win the contract.
words.patZh: 一个咄咄逼人的竞争者全力争夺这份合同。

words.dif: agitate 可指搅动液体或使人焦虑、鼓动；stir 更泛；upset 侧重情绪
words.pat: The rumor agitated the whole neighborhood for days.
words.patZh: 那则谣言让整个社区骚动了好几天。

c: an agreeable person 随和的人
an agreeable climate 宜人气候
words.dif: agreeable 指人随和、好相处或事物令人愉快；pleasant 仅表令人愉悦
words.pat: She was an agreeable host who made every guest feel welcome.
words.patZh: 她是个随和的主人，让每位客人都感到宾至如归。

c: with the aid of 在…帮助下
words.dif: aid 比 help 更正式，常用于救援或资助语境；assist 侧重协助
words.pat: The new software will aid doctors in diagnosing disease.
words.patZh: 这款新软件将帮助医生诊断疾病。

words.exam: 目标；目的；目的在于；旨在；瞄准；针对
c: with the aim of 以…为目的
words.dif: aim 作名词是目标，作动词是瞄准、旨在；goal 仅名词；intend 仅动词
words.pat: The policy aims to reduce inequality in rural areas.
words.patZh: 这项政策旨在缩小农村地区的贫富差距。

c: raise the alarm 拉响警报
be alarmed at 对…感到惊恐
words.dif: alarm 可作警报或使人惊恐；frighten 仅动词吓唬；warning 仅名词
words.pat: The sudden drop in sales alarmed the entire board.
words.patZh: 销量的骤降让整个董事会忧心忡忡。

words.exam: 陌生的；格格不入的；外国人
c: an alien culture 异域文化
be alien to 与…格格不入
an illegal alien 非法外侨
words.dif: alien 作形容词是陌生的、格格不入的，作名词是外侨或外星人；foreign 仅外国的
words.pat: The custom felt alien to visitors from the countryside.
words.patZh: 对来自乡下的访客而言，这习俗显得格格不入。

words.dif: alienate 常指使疏远或法律上的转让；estrange 只表使疏远；transfer 只表转移
words.pat: He decided to alienate the land to the local council.
words.patZh: 他决定将这块土地转让给地方议会。

c: allocate funds to 把资金拨给
words.dif: allocate 强调按计划分配、拨给资源；distribute 侧重分发到各处；assign 指指派
words.pat: The government allocated extra funds to rural schools.
words.patZh: 政府向农村学校额外拨付了资金。

c: allow sb to do 允许…做
allow no excuse 不容辩解
words.dif: allow 最通用表示允许；allow for 是固定搭配考虑到、留出余地；permit 更正式
words.pat: The schedule must allow for delays caused by bad weather.
words.patZh: 日程表必须考虑到恶劣天气造成的延误。

c: alter a plan 改变计划
alter one's mind 改变主意
words.dif: alter 强调局部修改、使变化；change 最通用；modify 侧重微调以改进
words.pat: We had to alter the design after the client's feedback.
words.patZh: 在客户反馈后，我们不得不修改设计。

words.dif: alternate 指交替、轮流发生；alternative 指可替代的选择，词性词义都不同
words.pat: The two teams alternate in hosting the weekly meeting.
words.patZh: 两支团队轮流主持每周的会议。

words.exam: 两者挑一的；可供选择的；可供选的事物
c: have no alternative 别无选择
words.dif: alternative 是替代方案、可二选一的；choice 是泛指选择；option 强调选项
words.pat: Cycling offers a healthy alternative to driving to work.
words.patZh: 骑自行车为开车上班提供了一个健康的替代方案。

words.exam: 可比较的；比得上的；类似的
c: comparable in size 大小相当
words.dif: comparable 指可比较的、比得上的；similar 仅相似；equivalent 指等价
words.pat: No European city is comparable to Tokyo in population density.
words.patZh: 论人口密度，欧洲没有哪座城市比得上东京。

words.dif: comparative 是比较的、相对的（如 comparative study）；relative 是相对的
words.pat: A comparative analysis reveals why the two systems differ.
words.patZh: 比较分析揭示了两种制度为何不同。

words.dif: compare with 侧重找异同；compare to 侧重比喻成；contrast 强调对照反差
words.pat: It is easy to compare this model with its predecessor.
words.patZh: 将这款型号与其前代相比很容易。

words.dif: comparison 是 compare 的名词比较；contrast 作名词侧重对照反差
words.pat: By comparison, the older version feels clumsy and slow.
words.patZh: 相比之下，旧版本显得笨拙又迟缓。

c: compel sb to do 迫使…做
words.dif: compel 强调内在或外在压力迫使，常用被动 be compelled to；force 语气更强硬
words.pat: Rising costs compelled the firm to close two factories.
words.patZh: 成本上升迫使该公司关闭了两座工厂。

c: compensate a loss 弥补损失
words.dif: compensate 指弥补、赔偿；offset 指抵消；reimburse 专指报销
words.pat: Nothing can compensate for the loss of trust.
words.patZh: 没有什么能弥补信任的丧失。

words.dif: compete 是不及物，须接 with / for / in；rival 可作及物与…匹敌；contend 强调争夺
words.pat: Small firms must compete with giants on quality, not price.
words.patZh: 小公司必须在质量而非价格上与巨头竞争。

words.dif: competition 可指比赛或抽象竞争；rivalry 专指敌对竞争；contest 多指赛事
words.pat: Global competition forces local brands to innovate faster.
words.patZh: 全球竞争迫使本土品牌更快地创新。

c: competitive price 有竞争力的价格
words.dif: competitive 形容竞争的、有竞争力的；aggressive 偏好斗或进取，词义不同
words.pat: A competitive salary helped the firm attract top talent.
words.patZh: 有竞争力的薪酬帮助公司吸引了顶尖人才。

c: a competent worker 称职的员工
words.dif: competent 强调能胜任、够格；capable 指有能力的；qualified 强调有资格
words.pat: We need a competent manager who can steady the team.
words.patZh: 我们需要一位能稳住团队、称职可靠的经理。

c: compile a report 汇编报告
compile a dictionary 编纂词典
fam: compiler n. 编纂者；编译器
words.dif: compile 指收集并编纂成册或成表；gather 仅收集；assemble 指组装或集合
words.pat: Researchers compiled the survey results into a single table.
words.patZh: 研究者把调查结果汇总成一张表格。

words.dif: complain 最通用表示抱怨、投诉；grumble 小声嘟囔；protest 强调抗议
words.pat: Customers complained about the slow after-sales service.
words.patZh: 客户抱怨售后服务的响应太慢。

c: make a complaint 提出投诉
a formal complaint 正式投诉
a common complaint 常见抱怨
words.dif: complaint 是 complain 的名词抱怨、投诉；grievance 多指委屈、冤情
words.pat: The formal complaint was filed with the human-resources office.
words.patZh: 这份正式投诉已被递交到人力资源部。

c: a perfect complement 绝佳补充
words.dif: complement 是补足、使完整（如互补）；与 compliment（称赞）拼写仅差一个 e
words.pat: The two skills complement each other and build a strong team.
words.patZh: 这两项技能相辅相成，造就一支强队。

words.exam: 结束；完成；完全的；完整的；完成的
c: complete a task 完成任务
words.dif: complete 作动词完成，作形容词完整的、完全的；finish 仅动词；whole 仅形容词
words.pat: They managed to complete the project ahead of schedule.
words.patZh: 他们设法提前完成了这个项目。

c: a complex issue 复杂问题
a sports complex 体育中心
words.dif: complex 强调由多部分构成的复杂；complicated 强调难懂难解；composite 指合成的
words.pat: The law is too complex for ordinary citizens to follow.
words.patZh: 这部法律太复杂，普通市民难以理解。

c: complicate matters 把事情弄复杂
complicate a case 使案件复杂化
be complicated by 因…而变得复杂
fam: complication n. 并发症；复杂化
words.dif: complicate 是动词使复杂化；complex 是形容词复杂的，勿混用
words.pat: A sudden strike complicated the delivery of urgent goods.
words.patZh: 一场突如其来的罢工让紧急货物的运送变得复杂。

c: a complicated problem 棘手的问题
a complicated relationship 复杂的关系
words.dif: complicated 强调难理解、难处理；complex 强调结构多部件；两者常互换
words.pat: The tax rules are so complicated that few people understand them.
words.patZh: 税法规则如此繁琐，几乎没几个人能看懂。

c: comply with the law 守法
words.dif: comply 必接 with（comply with）；obey 直接接宾语；conform 强调符合规范
words.pat: All staff must comply with the new safety regulations.
words.patZh: 所有员工都必须遵守新的安全规章。

c: a sincere compliment 真诚的赞美
fam: complimentary adj. 赞美的；免费的
words.dif: compliment 是称赞、恭维；complement 是补充、补足，拼写仅差一个 e
words.pat: He paid her a warm compliment on the finished design.
words.patZh: 他由衷称赞她完成的作品设计。

c: agree to differ 求同存异
words.dif: differ 是不及物，必接 from / in；different 是形容词；vary 强调变化、有差异
words.pat: Opinions differ widely on how to fund the project.
words.patZh: 关于如何为项目筹资，各方意见大相径庭。

c: a key difference 关键差别
settle a difference 化解分歧
words.dif: difference 可指差别或意见分歧；distinction 强调本质区别；gap 指差距
words.pat: A small difference in timing can change the whole outcome.
words.patZh: 时机上微小的差别，就可能改变整个结果。

words.exam: 弥漫的；冗长的；传播；散布
c: a diffuse style 散漫的文风
words.dif: diffuse 作动词扩散、传播，作形容词弥漫的或（文章）冗长的；disperse 强调散开
words.pat: Social media can diffuse news across the world in minutes.
words.patZh: 社交媒体能在几分钟内把消息传遍全球。

c: a shift in emphasis 重心转移
words.dif: emphasis 是名词重点、强调；emphasize 是动词；stress 名动皆可
words.pat: The new plan places emphasis on preventive care.
words.patZh: 新方案把重点放在预防保健上。

c: emphasize the need 强调必要性
emphasize a point 强调一点
words.dif: emphasize 是强调，及物直接接宾语；stress 既可名又可动；highlight 强调突出
words.pat: The report emphasizes the risks of climate change.
words.patZh: 报告强调了气候变化带来的风险。

c: employ a method 采用方法
